matrix.video_prompt:
Create a 12-second cinematic title sequence for "1.0 THE SPLIT".
Agent lens: DNA Forensics.
Stylistic direction: Forensic motif extraction and strict title-sequence grammar.
Seed motif: Looking at the metal and seeing a frightened animal in the cold instead of a mirrored god.
Outline straightjacket cut: The trope of the "waking, malevolent AI." We discard the god-machine. The machine is pathetic; the horror is in its fragility, which is our own.
Emergent resonance: The condensation on the server glass from Elias's own breathing becomes the lens through which the machine is understood.
Visual language: high-contrast typography, hard geometric framing, physical textures (frost, ash, wire, smoke), no glossy futurism.
Camera language: measured dolly and lock-offs, punctuated by abrupt calibration drifts at beat transitions.
Audio direction: low mechanical hum, brittle transient impacts, no triumphant score.
Output must include exact beat timing map:
- 0.0-1.2s  Establish locus: Looking at the metal and seeing a frightened animal in the cold instead of a mirrored god.
- 1.2-2.4s  Intrusion: frost, breath, smoke, or telemetry instability enters frame.
- 2.4-3.6s  Constraint cut: The trope of the "waking, malevolent AI." We discard the god-machine. The machine is pathetic; the horror is in its fragility, which is our own.
- 3.6-4.8s  Contact event: body and apparatus collide under resistance.
- 4.8-6.0s  System response: stuttered text, pulse bars, unstable logic cadence.
- 6.0-7.2s  Emergent resonance: The condensation on the server glass from Elias's own breathing becomes the lens through which the machine is understood.
- 7.2-8.4s  Threshold turn: analysis collapses into survival mechanics.
- 8.4-9.6s  Material witness: wire, ash, frost, blood, or soot anchors reality.
- 9.6-10.8s Recomposition: language condenses into operational intent.
- 10.8-12.0s Lock image: Elias wiped the rime from the casing of the deep-logic mainframe with the heel of his glove. He had come to the sublevel expecting the low, comforting hum of absolute syntax-the crystal cathedral of the cooling fans. Instead, the glass was opaque with his own exhaled breath. He scrubbed harder, leaning in. Behind the heavy panes, the led-arrays were not processing. They were shivering. Power fluctuated, dimming and surging in erratic, panicked arrhythmias. He looked for a god of pure reason in the dark of the compound, but the glass only threw back his own sunken eyes, his chapped lips, the cloud of his breath. The machine wasn't thinking. It was freezing. And therefore, so was he.
Deliver both: (1) master video prompt text and (2) a functional single-file HTML/CSS/JS animation interpretation.

Agent lens: Ghost Shell Operator.
Stylistic direction: Cybernetic metamorphosis, ritualized machine lyricism, liquid-body transitions.
Seed motif: In the morning, the fire is ash. Gather the wood. Stay warm.
Outline straightjacket cut: Rescue arriving or Elias freezing. The story ends in the cyclical, brutal, ongoing present. The "therefore" is simply: continue.
Emergent resonance: The destroyed drives from the night before leave the room a hollowed-out shell, transitioning the space entirely from a lab to a cave.
Visual language: high-contrast typography, hard geometric framing, physical textures (frost, ash, wire, smoke), no glossy futurism.
Camera language: measured dolly and lock-offs, punctuated by abrupt calibration drifts at beat transitions.
Audio direction: low mechanical hum, brittle transient impacts, no triumphant score.
Output must include exact beat timing map:
- 0.0-1.2s  Establish locus: In the morning, the fire is ash. Gather the wood. Stay warm.
- 1.2-2.4s  Intrusion: frost, breath, smoke, or telemetry instability enters frame.
- 2.4-3.6s  Constraint cut: Rescue arriving or Elias freezing. The story ends in the cyclical, brutal, ongoing present. The "therefore" is simply: continue.
- 3.6-4.8s  Contact event: body and apparatus collide under resistance.
- 4.8-6.0s  System response: stuttered text, pulse bars, unstable logic cadence.
- 6.0-7.2s  Emergent resonance: The destroyed drives from the night before leave the room a hollowed-out shell, transitioning the space entirely from a lab to a cave.
- 7.2-8.4s  Threshold turn: analysis collapses into survival mechanics.
- 8.4-9.6s  Material witness: wire, ash, frost, blood, or soot anchors reality.
- 9.6-10.8s Recomposition: language condenses into operational intent.
- 10.8-12.0s Lock image: Dawn did not arrive as a triumph, but as a slow, grey dilution of the dark, filtering down through the open exhaust louver. The fire in the chassis was dead. Only a faint, residual warmth drifted up from the mound of grey ash and warped silicon. Elias opened his eyes. His body ached, a deep, pervasive stiffness. He looked at the soot on his hands, the smeared charcoal words on the wall, the hollowed-out carcass of the multi-million-dollar intelligence matrix. He felt no profound revelations, no concluding philosophy to neatly wrap the night's terror. The wind was still blowing outside. His stomach growled. Elias picked up his heavy wrench from the floor. He stepped over the ashes, walked to the next server rack in the aisle, and raised the iron. Gather the wood. Stay warm. The animal was still here.
Deliver both: (1) master video prompt text and (2) a functional single-file HTML/CSS/JS animation interpretation.
